verses.en: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.pt: Graças te dou de todo o meu coração; diante dos deuses a ti canto louvores.
verses.en_web: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
verses.en_bbe: <Of David.> I will give you praise with all my heart: I will make melody to you before the gods.

verses.en: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
verses.pt: Inclino-me para o teu santo templo, e louvo o teu nome pela tua benignidade, e pela tua fidelidade; pois engrandeceste acima de tudo o teu nome e a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
verses.en_bbe: I will give worship before your holy Temple, praising your name for your mercy and for your unchanging faith: for you have made your word greater than all your name.

verses.en: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
verses.pt: No dia em que eu clamei, atendeste-me; alentaste-me, fortalecendo a minha alma.
verses.en_web: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
verses.en_bbe: When my cry came to your ears you gave me an answer, and made me great with strength in my soul.

verses.en: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
verses.pt: Todos os reis da terra de louvarão, ó Senhor, quando ouvirem as palavras da tua boca;
verses.en_web: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
verses.en_bbe: All the kings of the earth will give you praise, O Lord, when the words of your mouth come to their ears.

verses.en: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.
verses.pt: e cantarão os caminhos do Senhor, pois grande é a glória do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh; for great is Yahweh’s glory.
verses.en_bbe: They will make songs about the ways of the Lord; for great is the glory of the Lord.

verses.en: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
verses.pt: Ainda que o Senhor é excelso, contudo atenta para o humilde; mas ao soberbo, conhece-o de longe.
verses.en_web: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but the proud, he knows from afar.
verses.en_bbe: Though the Lord is high, he sees those who are low; and he has knowledge from far off of those who are lifted up.

verses.en: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
verses.pt: Embora eu ande no meio da angústia, tu me revivificas; contra a ira dos meus inimigos estendes a tua mão, e a tua destra me salva.
verses.en_web: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
verses.en_bbe: Even when trouble is round me, you will give me life; your hand will be stretched out against the wrath of my haters, and your right hand will be my salvation.

verses.en: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verses.pt: O Senhor aperfeiçoará o que me diz respeito. A tua benignidade, ó Senhor, dura para sempre; não abandones as obras das tuas mãos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me; your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will make all things complete for me: O Lord, your mercy is eternal; do not give up the works of your hands.
